I changed nothing in the repository; experiments ran on copies in <scratchpad>.

Most serious first:

1. RB-02 (major) - partial. The core defect still reproduces: `python -m tools.gie_registers stats` gives not_started 584/584 and 0 contributions; S00-ASG-01..07, S00-DEL-04, S00-ACC-05/06 are not_started with empty notes while B-001 is OPEN, and the generated docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md says "blocked (0) None". The validation rule exists and works once any status is set (12 problems on a scratch copy), but it is deliberately dormant while every status is not_started, so the matrix can reach the gate unchanged with CI green - the exact case the reviewer warned about. Notes for CR-001/CR-002/D-002/U-03 and the rendered REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX.md are in place.

2. RB-03 (major) - partial. Both gates are defined and "(already in 00)" is gone, but the documents again state different start rules: the graph's start gate has a third condition (contract_extensions integrated) that docs/WORKTREES.md omits, and WORKTREES adds "Sessions of the same wave start together". Taken literally the graph serialises wave 2 (S01 -> S02, S07 -> S08: CX-03 from S01 gates S07, CX-04 from S07 gates S08), which is the symptom the finding reported, and contradicts "contract_only dependencies never delay a start" in the same paragraph. CX-06 and CX-09 list S03 / S09 both as proposer and as the gated session. CR-003 says both "must exist before the listed sessions start" and "until a type exists a session works on labelled fixtures".

3. RB-10 - partial. The six named clauses are split, but "notes on the rest" covers 5 of 10: S12-ASG-02, -03, -04, -07 and S02-ASG-08 still have empty notes.

4. RB-06 - cannot_verify: tools/check_architecture.py does not exist, so the claimed ownership-coverage check cannot be checked. What I could verify is fine (0 unowned, 0 doubly owned of 196 files). Separate gap: docs/WORKTREES.md rule 2 still does not list the shared test files the finding named.

5. RB-09 - partial, minor: three of four notes are as claimed; S06-ACC-06 says only "both must be reported". The rule is prose only: sync-evidence derives one status from any test carrying the marker.

Other observations: none of tools/check_live_lock.py, check_architecture.py, check_docs_paths.py, check_no_secrets.py, check_protected_paths.py, baseline_freeze.py exists yet, so graph-level fixes (RB-03, 05, 06, 15) have no regression check; matrix wording fixes (RB-01, 07, 08, 11, 12) are protected only against deletion (minimum_requirement_count), not against re-wording.
